notes.title: Release Date Set - Coming July 31st!!!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="Cs71wz8hdAM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Celebrating the release date for my first game! FOOS started as a simple practice project to learn about Godot and expanded into a way to learn about publishing on Steam, but over time has morphed into a major passion project that I'm very happy to have this opportunity to share. [/p][p][/p][p]It's come a long way since the early days, [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177120/3b352bf4eea70a5796b41dfc070937df5510c02d.png"][/img][/p][p]and the story introduced in FOOS has much further to go throughout future projects. [/p][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy! [/p][p][/p][p]- Fletcher [/p]
